name: WHO Global Health Observatory
summary: World Health Organization health statistics by country or region, year and disaggregation such as sex, from the keyless GHO OData API.
notes: Keyless. An OData API: narrow answers with $filter (operators eq, ne, ge, lt joined by 'and'; functions contains() and date()); no other OData options are documented.
Find an indicator's code with indicators.list ($filter=contains(IndicatorName,'...')), then fetch its data with indicator.data.

Disaggregation is in Dim1 (e.g. Dim1 eq 'MLE' for male); Dim1 eq null keeps only non-disaggregated rows, Dim1 ne null only disaggregated ones. Filter years on TimeDimensionBegin with date(), e.g. date(TimeDimensionBegin) ge 2011-01-01.
No paging or size limits are documented; an unfiltered indicator returns every country and year.
